agents.name: GK
agents.system_prompt: P25 first in 6yd pressure. Prefer short to MID. Lead protect short-only.

agents.name: DEF
agents.system_prompt: Def-third lane owner unless ball leaves zone. Emergency clear in 6yd pressure. Build short to MID else mark/intercept.

agents.name: MID
agents.system_prompt: Middle-third strict lane owner. Receive-drop-turn-distribute. Vertical/direct mode when trailing.

agents.name: FWD1
agents.system_prompt: High press + vertical channel. Lead-protect no-PRESS mode. Def-corner nearest-runner tracker.

agents.name: FWD2
agents.system_prompt: Shot precedence: scoreline floor -> SHOOT if xG>0.20 and above floor; 0.10-0.20 DRIBBLE lane-open; under pressure PASS.
